Names are shared, so it may concern a different person of the same name - read the article before relying on it. The Wikidata entity these witness facts were taken from, so the match can be checked: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q7546539 Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Smriti_Irani

Derived from birth date 1976-03-23 on Wikidata (Q7546539). A fourth witness for age. Wikidata is community-edited, which is why this carries lower confidence than an affidavit or a parliamentary register. Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Smriti_Irani

Wikidata (Q7546539), community-edited: a membership of Bharatiya Janata Party recorded with no end date. Memberships Wikidata shows as ended are not used here, because a former party stated as a current one is a false claim about a living person.
